messages:
Jamie: Heads-up — changelog cutoff for 0.9.0 is Tue Mar 24 09:00 PT. Please add a changelog entry to your PRs (or mark as changelog/skip). I'm going to enable a stricter check on Monday that will block merges without an entry. Ping if you think your PR should be exempt.
Kevin: Quick q — what exactly counts as an "entry"? one-sentence summary + category?
Jamie: Yes. One short sentence under one of the categories (Added / Changed / Fixed / Deprecated / Removed / Security). Include a component tag and PR link if useful. Example: `### Fixed\n- TLS fallback on load balancer (fixes #1234) — @kevin (PR #3456)`
Sophie: Where should that live? PR body or a file?
Jamie: Prefer PR body under a "Changelog entry" heading. We also accept files at `docs/changelog/unreleased/<pr-number>.md` but PR body is easiest for reviewers.
release-bot: :robot_face: Reminder: please add label `changelog/entry` or `changelog/skip` to your PR. Missing label by Mon 08:00 PT will mark the PR as `changelog-required`.
Mike: I'm OOO Mon morning. If infra PRs need short entries, can someone volunteer to help backfill? I can write the big ones after lunch.
Aria: I can sweep infra and infra-deps PRs Mon 10:00–12:00 PT and add suggested one-liners in each PR. I'll also open small PRs at `docs/changelog/unreleased/` where appropriate.
Jamie: Awesome — thanks Aria. Mike, if you can drop a shortlist of the highest-priority infra PRs that need help, I'll triage.
Kevin: Also can the changelog-check be non-blocking for hotfix branches (hotfix/*)? We want to allow quick branch bumps without delaying rollback merges.
Jamie: Good point. I'll exempt `hotfix/*` and `release/*-hotfix` branches from the blocker. Will post the exact config in this channel after I update the CI.
Aria: Small nit — the template we're using recommends categories and a 1-line style. See `docs/release/CHANGELOG_TEMPLATE.md` — categories: Added, Changed, Fixed, Deprecated, Removed, Security.
Jamie: If helpful I can sketch a tiny script to auto-create `docs/changelog/unreleased/<pr-number>.md` from the PR title and a short sentence. Anyone want to own reviewing that?
Mike: +1 from deploy automation team, can review and make sure it fits our release automation.
Jamie: Cool. I'll open a draft PR later today. For now: if you're merging between now and cutoff, double-check your PR body and add label. Thanks everyone :pray:
Sophie: thanks — will add entries to the two feature PRs I'm landing today.
Aria: will post updates in this thread when sweep starts. :eyes:
